title: Technology - Application Development, Summer Analyst, Warsaw 2027
description:
You are the brain behind our work … 
 At Citi, we do not just adapt to change – we drive it. Our Summer Technology Analyst Program is where forward thinking talents meet unparalleled opportunities. This is your chance to innovate, influence, and make an impact in the most global financial institution!
 Citi Technology partners to ensure that Citi’s platforms can “Be the Best” for clients globally, with a diverse and ethical workforce that applies innovation and automation to deliver a world class client experience and strengthen our reputation. We have over 30,000 technologists globally who are dedicated to serving our clients’ needs across the firm. By utilizing a broad range of technologies, we are at the forefront of innovation. We seek to drive our systems and processes towards scalable, low-latency, high-performance enterprise systems to support Citi’s strategic priorities.
 We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed… 
 We are committed to teaching you the ropes. The Summer Analyst Program starts in June with an in-depth education on the Analyst role’s fundamentals and the nuances of Citi’s culture. The program also includes on-the-desk training, an informative speaker series, and networking opportunities. Summer Analysts often return to Citi after graduating from university to become Full-Time Analysts and continue their career in technology. 
 Your time here will look like this...  
 You will work in an agile software development environment, developing quality and scalable software solutions using leading-edge technologies. Based on business requirements, you will develop code consistent with quality standards and offer support during testing cycles and post-production deployment. To ensure defect-free programming, you will use the appropriate tools to test and debug code and participate in the review of peer coding. You have additional support, too. You join a cohort of other new hires and go through training together to learn about our company, our tools and processes, and the technical skills you will need to succeed.
 While technologies can vary slightly from team to team, some developers will have exposure within the following categories:
 Back-End Development: Java, Python, Spring Framework
 Front-End Development: Web (React, TypeScript, Angular, HTML5) and Mobile (Swift, Kotlin)
 Generative AI & AI Agents : GitHub Copilot with various models, Citi Squad (automated code reviews), Devin.AI (Agentic Code generation), Prompt Engineering, Workflow Design, GenAI Optimization, Stylus Workspaces (In-house Gemini)
 Data Analytics: Utilizing tools like Splunk, Tableau, and Adobe Analytics to track customer journey adoption and measure the business value of delivered products.
 No matter your team placement, as a member in our program, you can expect:
 ·         Global Exposure : Work in globally scoped projects with cross-functional teams and gain insights into how technology drives the financial sector worldwide.
 ·         Continuous Learning: Benefit from structured learning, networking, mentoring, and development programs that are designed to sharpen your technical prowess, enhance your business insight, and cultivate your leadership skills.
 ·         Real Impact : Contribute to real-world projects that shape the future of banking, from developing next-gen digital banking solutions to enhancing cybersecurity defenses and driving data-powered innovations.
 To join Citi, you should meet the following criteria: 
 ·         Graduation between Dec 2027 and July 2028.
 ·         Educational background: Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, or other tech related degrees.
 ·         A proactive problem-solver who thrives on innovation and embraces challenges with enthusiasm, leveraging Generative AI to address complex business problems and create novel solutions. 
 ·         Possess a global outlook and willingness to collaborate across cultures and time zones.
 ·         Have excellent communication skills, project management, leadership, attention to detail, and the ability to work well within diverse teams.
 ·         Ability to pass technical interviews consisting of basic algorithmic programming exercises.
 ·         Must be collaborative and adaptable, with excellent communication skills. Prior experience working in agile teams is desirable.
 ·         Work Authorization: Authorized to work in Poland without the need for employer sponsorship, now or in the future. 
 Who we think will be a great fit... 
 A steadfast dedication to learning and a true passion for business are vital. As global industries continue to evolve, we are seeking professionals who bring a global perspective to the future of banking and are eager to make an impact at the corporate level using AI. We value diversity and so do you.
 This program is ideal for those who:
 ·         Are ambitious, with a relentless drive to succeed in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
 ·         Are curious about how technology can revolutionize finance and are eager to be at the forefront of this transformation.
 ·         Want to grow into a future tech leader, with a passion for both technology and its application in the global financial industry.
 By joining Citi Solutions Center Poland, you will not only be part of a business casual workplace with a hybrid working model (currently up to 2 days working at home per week), but also (potentially, subject to final offer) receive a competitive base salary and enjoy a whole host of additional benefits which can include: 
 ·         Employer paid Defined Contribution Pension Plan contribution of 6% of employee’s pensionable earnings (PPE Program) 
 ·         Employer paid Private Medical Care Package for employees and Private Medical Care Packages for certain family members available at preferential rates 
 ·         Employer paid Life Insurance Program for employees and Life Insurance for certain family members available at preferential rates  
 ·         Employee Assistance Program financed by Employer  
 ·         Paid Parental Leave Program (maternity and paternity leave; statutory and 2 weeks additional paid paternity leave)  
 ·         Sport Card for employees subsidised via Social Benefits Fund and Sport Cards for certain family members available at preferential rates  
 ·         Additional benefits from Company’s Social Benefit Fund, in particular: Holidays Allowance, support for sport and cultural activities, team building events. 
 ·         Additional day off for volunteering 
 ·         Cafeteria/ flex benefit – a company benefits system which enables employees to select and purchase benefits offered by a provider and available for employees on the platform. 
 ·         Opportunity to receive an annual discretionary incentive award 
 ·         Special offers and discounts for employees 
 ·         Copy and paste the URL below into a new tab on your web browser to view the  Remuneration Regulations  extract: 
 https://tbcdn.talentbrew.com/company/287/cms/v3/docs/policies/RemunerationRegulations-KeyProvisions-CitibankEurope_plc_05012025_A.pdf 
 Alongside these benefits Citi is committed to ensuring our workplace is where everyone feels comfortable coming to work as their whole self every day.  We want the best talent around the world to be energized to join us, motivated to stay, and empowered to thrive.  
 Sounds like Citi has everything you need? Then apply to discover the true extent of your capabilities.

 Your time here will look something like this... 
 The 10-week Summer Analyst Program starts in June and begins with in-depth training. People learn differently, so we combine formal training with a complete hands-on experience to help you quickly ramp up and adapt to your role and the culture at Citi. There will be ongoing sales, credit, product, technology, and professional skills training throughout the program along with a robust junior and senior mentorship structure to help you develop professionally.
 By the conclusion of the Program, you can expect to have thorough experience with and a strong understanding of:
 The CCB target market, value proposition, and client coverage model
 How bankers interact with clients and identify their needs
 The various credit product types and how these solutions best fit client needs
 The commercial loan underwriting process, including loan structuring and documentation
 The end-to-end credit process including new origination of credit and the monitoring of a credit portfolio
 Engaging with clients, prospects, and centers of influence
 Citi credit and regulatory policies and procedures
 We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed.
 You will join a Coverage team for the duration of the Program, working directly with Relationship Managers on a portfolio of clients and interfacing with teams across the firm. The role of Coverage team members is to serve as a thought partner to our clients, working closely with them to deliver the full breadth of Citi’s solutions to help them fund their operations and expand both locally and overseas.
 Analysts play a critical role in meeting the needs of our clients and prospects, including:
 Conducting company research and industry analysis
 Analyzing financial data and performing financial modeling focused on company valuations, discounted cash flow analysis, and pro-forma analyses
 Supporting the commercial lending process, which includes secured and unsecured revolving lines of credit, term loans, syndicated loans, leveraged loans, cross-border loans approved locally and extended overseas through the CCB’s global network of 26 countries
 Taking ownership of the client experience, including partnering with Bankers and Product teams to determine which products to leverage in order to help clients achieve their goals
 Playing a role in deal management and client presentation preparation, including creating business development presentations, pitch books, prospect memos, and other client-related decks
 Interacting with partners across the firm, including product, credit risk, in-business controls, legal, marketing, operations, risk, compliance, and technology teams
 We want to hear from you if: 
 You are a dynamic individual who is passionate about partnering with stakeholders to achieve goals
 You have strong analytical and problem-solving skills
 You are majoring in Finance or Accounting, or have experience in Financial Services through clubs or internships
 You are in your penultimate year of a Bachelor's or Master's degree in any discipline from a top academic institution (graduating between Dec 2027 – June 2028).
 You have obtained a preferred GPA of 3.5 or above
 You are a proficient user of MS Word, Access, Excel, and PowerPoint

Internal Audit is a change agent within Citi aimed to enhance the control culture of Citi worldwide and thereby support senior management decision making around the globe.
 We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed. 
 Citi’s Internal Audit Summer Analyst Program is a 16-week internship opportunity in Mississauga, ON. This Program will provide development-focused opportunities coupled with structured classroom training, mentoring and individual development.  Your time here will look something like this... 
 The Internal Audit Summer Analyst program begins in May with a 3-day training program, providing Summer Analysts with an overview of Citi and an introduction to Citi’s Internal Audit Organization. The Summer Analysts will receive real-world work, and will be expected to add value to their teams during the 16 weeks. In addition to their daily work, the Summer Analysts will also have the opportunity to network with other Citi interns, current program participants, and other IA professionals. The program concludes with the Summer Analysts presenting their accomplishments and lessons learned to the Senior IA Management team. Top performing Summer Analysts will be considered for the full time Internal Audit Analyst Programs.

title: Functions - Finance, Summer Associate, Charlotte - USA, 2027
description:
You're the brains behind our work.
 You're ready to bring your knowledge from the classroom to the boardroom — and Citi wants to help you get there! Citi's Global Functions business division is looking for driven Associates to join the Corporate Finance team in the US. Our Financial Management Associate (FMA) internship program is designed to accelerate your career by giving you exposure to Corporate Finance, helping you discover your best-fit path at Citi. Citi offers significant opportunities for career growth and internal mobility.
 We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed.
 The FMA Program is a global leadership development program for Masters and MBA grads, built to create a pipeline of future Corporate Finance leaders. Summer FMAs will have the opportunity to work closely with senior managers in key disciplines including Controllers, Treasury, Financial Planning & Analysis, Tax, and business-aligned Chief Finance Offices.
 The Summer FMA program is unique due to the various product/function/legal entity perspectives FMAs experience. The program is ten weeks in length; allowing FMAs to work on challenging projects designed to test skills while providing a learning opportunity and adding value. The Summer FMA Program is a significant feeder pool for the Full-Time FMA Program. The program consists of roles that are identified and aligned with Citi Finance objectives, structured for completion within a two-month time frame, report to Finance professionals that can provide appropriate leadership direction, and provide the candidate with a variety of development opportunities and skills.
 As an FMA, you'll help drive Citi Finance's 4 priorities: champion financial performance & strategic execution, generate value & optimize resources, accelerate finance transformation & controls, and develop our people & culture — all while enjoying:
 Senior Access – Exposure to Citi's senior Corporate Finance leaders who guide your growth
 Global Reach – Build a network of relationships across the global Citi Finance community
 Leadership – Sharpen your management skills through rotational responsibility
 Responsibility – High impact work aligned with Citi’s growth strategy
 Empowerment – FMAs are challenged to become involved in the fast-paced analytical and dynamic financial environment
 Your time here will look something like this...
 Summer associates will receive an orientation to Citi, including business overviews from senior leaders across the firm. Training will highlight current topics in the banking industry, technical finance and accounting skills, and communication and presentation skills. Summer associates will also be matched with mentors who can offer guidance and support throughout the program. As summer associates, your day-to-day duties will vary depending on your placement.
 We want to hear from you if...
 You are currently pursuing an MBA or Master's degree in Accounting, Financial Strategy, Finance, Economics, or other related fields
 You're excited about building a career in Corporate Finance
 You bring at least 3 years of significant, related full-time professional experience
 You're graduating between December 2027 – June 2028
 You won't require sponsorship for U.S. work authorization or at time of hire
 Professional certifications such as CPA, CFA, FRM, or multilingual capabilities are considered a plus, but are not required.
 Who we think will be a great fit...
 We're excited to meet motivated, globally minded MBA and MA graduates with an innovative outlook on business who bring:
 A strategic, analytical mindset with a global perspective and a genuine passion for driving Citi Finance’s 4 Pillars.
 Initiative, creativity, and professional maturity, paired with resiliency and a growth mindset
 A sense of urgency, excellent judgment, and the confidence to step outside your comfort zone
 Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to build lasting business relationships and turn complex financial insights into clear, compelling stories
 A knack for process improvement — including technology-driven automation and optimization
 Technical proficiency in Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
 An AI-literate, forward-thinking mindset — eager to apply generative AI and emerging technologies to solve complex finance problems
 A demonstrated interest in Data Analytics, Database Management, Information Systems, or Digital Technology
 Sound risk management judgment — the ability to identify, assess, and escalate risk in a complex, regulated environment
 Annual Salary: $105,000

description:
You're the brains behind our work.
 You're ready to bring your knowledge from the classroom to the boardroom — and Citi wants to help you get there! Citi's Global Functions business division is looking for driven Associates to join the Corporate Finance team in the US. Our Financial Management Associate (FMA) internship program is designed to accelerate your career by giving you exposure to Corporate Finance, helping you discover your best-fit path at Citi. Citi offers significant opportunities for career growth and internal mobility.
 We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed.
 The FMA Program is a global leadership development program for Masters and MBA grads, built to create a pipeline of future Corporate Finance leaders. Summer FMAs will have the opportunity to work closely with senior managers in key disciplines including Controllers, Treasury, Financial Planning & Analysis, Tax, and business-aligned Chief Finance Offices.
 The Summer FMA program is unique due to the various product/function/legal entity perspectives FMAs experience. The program is ten weeks in length; allowing FMAs to work on challenging projects designed to test skills while providing a learning opportunity and adding value. The Summer FMA Program is a significant feeder pool for the Full-Time FMA Program. The program consists of roles that are identified and aligned with Citi Finance objectives, structured for completion within a two-month time frame, report to Finance professionals that can provide appropriate leadership direction, and provide the candidate with a variety of development opportunities and skills.
 As an FMA, you'll help drive Citi Finance's 4 priorities: champion financial performance & strategic execution, generate value & optimize resources, accelerate finance transformation & controls, and develop our people & culture — all while enjoying:
 Senior Access – Exposure to Citi's senior Corporate Finance leaders who guide your growth
 Global Reach – Build a network of relationships across the global Citi Finance community
 Leadership – Sharpen your management skills through rotational responsibility
 Responsibility – High impact work aligned with Citi’s growth strategy
 Empowerment – FMAs are challenged to become involved in the fast-paced analytical and dynamic financial environment
 Your time here will look something like this...
 Summer associates will receive an orientation to Citi, including business overviews from senior leaders across the firm. Training will highlight current topics in the banking industry, technical finance and accounting skills, and communication and presentation skills. Summer associates will also be matched with mentors who can offer guidance and support throughout the program. As summer associates, your day-to-day duties will vary depending on your placement.
 We want to hear from you if...
 You are currently pursuing an MBA or Master's degree in Accounting, Financial Strategy, Finance, Economics, or other related fields
 You're excited about building a career in Corporate Finance
 You bring at least 3 years of significant, related full-time professional experience
 You're graduating between December 2027 – June 2028
 You won't require sponsorship for U.S. work authorization or at time of hire
 Professional certifications such as CPA, CFA, FRM, or multilingual capabilities are considered a plus, but are not required.
 Who we think will be a great fit...
 We're excited to meet motivated, globally minded MBA and MA graduates with an innovative outlook on business who bring:
 A strategic, analytical mindset with a global perspective and a genuine passion for driving Citi Finance’s 4 Pillars.
 Initiative, creativity, and professional maturity, paired with resiliency and a growth mindset
 A sense of urgency, excellent judgment, and the confidence to step outside your comfort zone
 Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to build lasting business relationships and turn complex financial insights into clear, compelling stories
 A knack for process improvement — including technology-driven automation and optimization
 Technical proficiency in Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
 An AI-literate, forward-thinking mindset — eager to apply generative AI and emerging technologies to solve complex finance problems
 A demonstrated interest in Data Analytics, Database Management, Information Systems, or Digital Technology
 Sound risk management judgment — the ability to identify, assess, and escalate risk in a complex, regulated environment

 Citi Technology partners to ensure that Citi’s platforms can “Be the Best” for clients globally, with a diverse and ethical workforce that applies innovation and automation to deliver a world class client experience and strengthen our reputation. We have over 30,000 technologists globally who are dedicated to serving our clients’ needs across the firm. By utilizing a broad range of technologies, we are at the forefront of innovation. We seek to drive our systems and processes towards scalable, low-latency, high frequency enterprise systems to support Citi’s strategic priorities.   
 We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed…   
 We are committed to teaching you the ropes. The Summer Analyst Program starts in early June with an in-depth education on the Analyst role’s fundamentals and the nuances of Citi’s culture. The program also includes on-the-desk training, an informative speaker series, and networking opportunities. Summer Analysts often return to Citi after graduating from university to become Full-Time Analysts and continue their career in technology.   
 Your time here will look something like this...   
 Our technological solutions are the foundations of everything we do. We keep the bank safe and provide the technical tools our workers need to be successful. We design our digital architecture and ensure our platforms provide a first-class customer experience. Our operations teams manage risk, resources, and program management. We focus on enterprise resiliency and business continuity. We develop, coordinate, and execute strategic operational plans. Essentially, Chief Information Security Office (CISO) works together to ensure the safety of Citi’s and our clients’ assets and information.  
 You will make tangible contributions to high-impact, real-world projects that directly influence the evolution of banking. Your work could involve anything from developing next-generation digital banking solutions and fortifying our cybersecurity defenses to driving data-powered innovations and transforming customer experiences. Be a part of impactful initiatives that shape the future of finance.  
 While technologies can vary slightly from team to team, Analysts will have exposure within the following categories:   
 Microservices Developer: Java, Spring Framework, Pivotal Cloud Foundry  
 Front-End Web Development : React or Angular, Apigee TypeScript, HTML5  
 Generative AI & AI Agents : GitHub Copilot with various models, Citi Squad (automated code reviews), Devin.AI (Agentic Code generation), Prompt Engineering, Workflow Design, GenAI Optimization, Stylus Workspaces (In-house Gemini)  
 Data Analytics: Utilizing tools like Splunk, Tableau, and Adobe Analytics to track customer journey adoption and measure the business value of delivered products.  
No matter your team placement, as a member in our program, you can expect:  
 Global Exposure: Work in globally scoped projects with cross-functional teams and gain insights into how technology drives the financial sector worldwide.  
 Continuous Learning: Benefit from structured learning, networking, mentoring, and development programs that are designed to sharpen your technical prowess, enhance your business insight, and cultivate your leadership skills.  
 Real Impact: Contribute to real-world projects that shape the future of banking, from developing next-gen digital banking solutions to enhancing our cybersecurity defenses and driving data-powered innovations.  
 To join Citi, you should meet the following criteria:  
 Graduation between Dec 2027 and May 2028.  
 Educational background: Bachelor’s degree in Cyber Security, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, or other tech related degrees.  
 GPA of 3.0 or better is preferred.    
 A proactive problem-solver who thrives on innovation and embraces challenges with enthusiasm, leveraging Generative AI to address complex business problems and create novel solutions.  
 Possess a global outlook and willingness to collaborate across cultures and time zones.  
 Have excellent communication skills, project management, leadership, attention to detail, and the ability to work well within diverse teams.  
 Ability to pass technical interviews consisting of basic algorithmic programming exercises.  
 Must be collaborative and adaptable, with excellent communication skills. Prior experience working in agile teams is desirable.  
 Work Authorization: Authorized to work in (United States of America) without the need for employer sponsorship, now or in the future.  
 Who we think will be a great fit...   
 A steadfast dedication to learning and a true passion for business are vital. As global industries continue to evolve, we are seeking professionals who bring a global perspective to the future of banking and are eager to make an impact at the corporate level using AI. We value diversity and so do you.   
 This program is ideal for those who:  
 Are ambitious, with a relentless drive to succeed in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.  
 Are curious about how technology can revolutionize finance and are eager to be at the forefront of this transformation.  
 Want to grow into a future tech leader, with a passion for both technology and its application in the global financial industry.  
 Salary: $90,000 USD

That means knowing all about our deposit and lending, as well as our cash management, trade, FX (foreign exchange) and capital markets solutions. The Summer Analyst Program strives to bring in the best and brightest talent and support them as they develop into the next generation of commercial banking leaders globally.
 Your time here will look something like this... 
 The 10-week Summer Analyst Program starts in June and begins with in-depth training. People learn differently, so we combine formal training with a complete hands-on experience to help you quickly ramp up and adapt to your role and the culture at Citi. There will be ongoing sales, credit, product, technology, and professional skills training throughout the program along with a robust junior and senior mentorship structure to help you develop professionally.
 By the conclusion of the Program, you can expect to have thorough experience with and a strong understanding of:
 The CCB target market, value proposition, and client coverage model
 How bankers interact with clients and identify their needs
 The various credit product types and how these solutions best fit client needs

 The end-to-end credit process including new origination of credit and the monitoring of a credit portfolio
 Engaging with clients, prospects, and centers of influence
 Citi credit and regulatory policies and procedures

 Conducting company research and industry analysis
 Analyzing financial data and performing financial modeling focused on company valuations, discounted cash flow analysis, and pro-forma analyses

title: Technology, Production Support, Summer Analyst, New York - USA, 2027
description:
You are the brains behind our work … 
 At Citi, we do not just adapt to change – we drive it. Our Summer Technology Analyst Program is where forward thinking talents meet unparalleled opportunities. This is your chance to innovate, influence, and make an impact in the most global financial institution!
 Citi Technology partners to ensure that Citi’s platforms can “Be the Best” for clients globally, with a diverse and ethical workforce that applies innovation and automation to deliver a world class client experience and strengthen our reputation. We have over 30,000 technologists globally who are dedicated to serving our clients’ needs across the firm. By utilizing a broad range of technologies, we are at the forefront of innovation. We seek to drive our systems and processes towards scalable, low-latency, high frequency enterprise systems to support Citi’s strategic priorities.
 We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed… 
 We are committed to teaching you the ropes. The Summer Analyst Program starts in early June with an in-depth education on the Analyst role’s fundamentals and the nuances of Citi’s culture. The program also includes on-the-desk training, an informative speaker series, and networking opportunities. Summer Analysts often return to Citi after graduating from university to become Full-Time Analysts and continue their career in technology.
 Your time here will look like this... 
 Advancing our technological capabilities day after day not only delivers seamless services to the bank but works towards building the flexible systems that will define the digital bank of tomorrow. The Production Support team is at the forefront of maintaining and optimizing critical live production systems, ensuring their health, stability, and peak performance so that Citi can confidently conduct business and service clients. Our analysts use their problem solving and technical skills to quickly resolve any issues, which can vary in severity and complexity and may impact Citi’s reputation or profits. Production support analysts are often ‘the bridge’ between technology and the business, so they quickly become equipped with extensive business knowledge, as well as technical skills.
 As a Production Support Analyst, you will work in a dynamic environment that adapts to the needs and priorities of various organizations: Services, Markets, Banking, Functions and Data. This role offers a unique blend of business knowledge and technical expertise, empowering you to swiftly troubleshoot complex problems and engineer robust solutions. Your core mission will be to guarantee production stability, providing an always available and resilient technological backbone for our clients. This involves coordinating with other technology partners such as developers, business teams, etc. to monitor the end-to-end application environment in real-time.
 While technologies can vary slightly from team to team, Analysts will have exposure within the following categories:
 Hands-On Incident & Problem Management: Gain direct exposure to supporting our clients through the entire lifecycle of incident and problem management. You'll develop critical problem-solving skills and learn how to manage complex technical challenges under pressure.
 Enhancing Monitoring & Alerting Systems: Contribute to the continuous improvement of our sophisticated monitoring capabilities. You'll work with industry-standard tools like ITRS Geneos and Grafana to build and refine platforms that proactively identify and alert on production issues, enabling rapid resolution.
 Developing Innovative Tooling & Automation: Unleash your coding potential! You'll have the exciting opportunity to design, develop, and implement custom applications and scripts that automate processes, improve efficiency, and empower your team.
 Elevate your technical skills: As a Production Support Analyst, you'll master Linux/Unix, hone database expertise (SQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL), and build automation with Python. You'll gain experience with application servers, web technologies, and strengthen networking knowledge. This role offers hands-on use of monitoring tools (ITRS Geneos, Grafana) and exposure to cloud and containerization (Kubernetes), ensuring continuous growth in a dynamic production environment.
 While technologies can vary slightly from team to team, Analysts will have exposure within the following categories:
 Microservices Developer : Java, Spring Framework, Pivotal Cloud Foundry
 Front-End Web Development: React or Angular, Apigee TypeScript, HTML5
 Generative AI & AI Agents: GitHub Copilot with various models, Citi Squad (automated code reviews), Devin.AI (Agentic Code generation), Prompt Engineering, Workflow Design, GenAI Optimization, Stylus Workspaces (In-house Gemini)
 Data Analytics: Utilizing tools like Splunk, Tableau, and Adobe Analytics to track customer journey adoption and measure the business value of delivered products.
No matter your team placement, as a member in our program, you can expect:
 Global Exposure : Work in globally scoped projects with cross-functional teams and gain insights into how technology drives the financial sector worldwide.
 Continuous Learning: Benefit from structured learning, networking, mentoring, and development programs that are designed to sharpen your technical prowess, enhance your business insight, and Real Impact : Contribute to real-world projects that shape the future of banking, from developing next-gen digital banking solutions to enhancing our cybersecurity defenses and driving data-powered innovations.
 To join Citi, you should meet the following criteria: 
 Graduation between Dec 2027 and May 2028.
 Educational background: Bachelor’s degree Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, or other tech related degrees.
 GPA of 3.0 or better is preferred. 
 A proactive problem-solver who thrives on innovation and embraces challenges with enthusiasm, leveraging Generative AI to address complex business problems and create novel solutions. 
 Possess a global outlook and willingness to collaborate across cultures and time zones.
 Have excellent communication skills, project management, leadership, attention to detail, and the ability to work well within diverse teams.
 Ability to pass technical interviews consisting of basic algorithmic programming exercises.
 Must be collaborative and adaptable, with excellent communication skills. Prior experience working in agile teams is desirable.
 Work Authorization: Authorized to work in US without the need for employer sponsorship, now or in the future. 
 Who we think will be a great fit... 
 A steadfast dedication to learning and a true passion for business are vital. As global industries continue to evolve, we are seeking professionals who bring a global perspective to the future of banking and are eager to make an impact at the corporate level using AI. We value diversity and so do you.
 This program is ideal for those who:
 Are ambitious, with relentless drive to succeed in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
 Are curious about how technology can revolutionize finance and are eager to be at the forefront of this transformation.
 Want to grow into a future tech leader, with a passion for both technology and its application in the global financial industry.
 Annual Salary =  $105,000

description:
You are the brains behind our work … 
 At Citi, we do not just adapt to change – we drive it. Our Full Time Technology Analyst Program is where forward thinking talents meet unparalleled opportunities. This is your chance to innovate, influence, and make an impact in the most global financial institution! 
 Citi Technology partners to ensure that Citi’s platforms can “Be the Best” for clients globally, with a diverse and ethical workforce that applies innovation and automation to deliver a world class client experience and strengthen our reputation. We have over 30,000 technologists globally who are dedicated to serving our clients’ needs across the firm. By utilizing a broad range of technologies, we are at the forefront of innovation. We seek to drive our systems and processes towards scalable, low-latency, high frequency enterprise systems to support Citi’s strategic priorities. 
 We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed… 
 We are committed to teaching you the ropes. The Summer Analyst Program starts in early June with an in-depth education on the Analyst role’s fundamentals and the nuances of Citi’s culture. The program also includes on-the-desk training, an informative speaker series, and networking opportunities. Summer Analysts often return to Citi after graduating from university to become Full-Time Analysts and continue their career in technology. 
 Your time here will look something like this... 
 You will work in an agile software development environment, developing quality and scalable software solutions using leading-edge technologies. Based on business requirements, you will develop code consistent with quality standards and offer support during testing cycles and post-production deployment. To ensure defect-free programming, you will use the appropriate tools to test and debug code and participate in the review of peer coding. You have additional support, too. You join with a cohort of other new hires and go through training together to learn about our company, our tools and processes, and the technical skills you will need to succeed. 
 While technologies can vary slightly from team to team, some developer will have exposure within the following categories: 
 Microservices Developer: Java, Spring Framework, Pivotal Cloud Foundry 
 iOS: Swift, Xcode, MVC Architecture 
 Android: Java, Android Studio, JavaScript, CSS, AJAX, Java Web Services 
 Generative AI tools:   Github, Co-Pilot for code generation, for automated code reviews, etc. 
 Web: Angular (latest version), Eclipse, Java, JSP, TypeScript, HTML, JavaScript, CSS, AJAX 
 While other developers will be exposed to the following: 
 Data Analytics tools such as Splunk, Tableau, and Adobe Analytics to track adoption of customer journeys and derive business value of delivered product. 
 Cloud adoption strategy with Citi APis getting deployed in diverse cloud providers such as AWS etc. 
 Engineering Excellence practices: Minimum Development Standards and Minimum Operational standards set and followed at CITI.  
 Understand latest design and software architecture patterns and frameworks: Microservices, APIs, Spring Core/MVC/Boot/Cloud, REST and so on.  
 CI/CD with exposure to various software development tools like: JIRA, Zephry, BitBucket, TeamCity, uDeploy, Artifactory, Openshift(ECS/Docker)  
 Event streaming/messaging systems using KAFKA, Solace, and Aeron or similar technology.  
 Exposure to Containers using Docker/Kubernetes.  
No matter your team placement, as a member in our program, you can expect: 
 Global Exposure : Work in globally scoped projects with cross-functional teams and gain insights into how technology drives the financial sector worldwide. 
 Continuous Learning: Benefit from structured learning, networking, mentoring, and development programs that are designed to sharpen your technical prowess, enhance your business insight, and cultivate your leadership skills. 
 Real Impact : Contribute to real-world projects that shape the future of banking, from developing next-gen digital banking solutions to enhancing our cybersecurity defenses and driving data-powered innovations. 
 We want to hear from you if... 
 We are in the hunt for trailblazers with a passion for technology and drive to make a difference. 
 To join this elite program, you should: 
 Be graduating between December 2026 and July 2027 
 Pursuing Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Management Information Systems, or other tech related degree. 
 Achieved or on track to achieve a 2.1 and above 
 Be a problem solver who thrives on innovation and enjoys tackling challenges head-on. 
 Possess a global outlook and willingness to collaborate across cultures and time zones. 
 Have excellent communication skills, project management, leadership, attention to detail, and the ability to work well within diverse teams. 
 Ability to pass technical interviews consisting of basic algorithmic programming exercises. 
 Must be collaborative and adaptable, with excellent communication skills. Prior experience working in agile teams is desirable. 
 Who we think will be a great fit... 
 A dedication to learning and a true passion for business are vital. As industries all over the globe continue to restructure and grow, we are hiring professionals who have a global perspective on the future of banking and want to make an impact on the corporate level. We value diversity and so do you. This program is ideal for those who: 
 Are ambitious, with relentless drive to succeed in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. 
 Are curious about how technology can revolutionize finance and are eager to be at the forefront of this transformation. 
 Want to grow into a future tech leader, with a passion for both technology and its application in the global financial industry.

Corporate Bankers are relationship-focused finance professionals responsible for understanding the wide range of complex financial issues facing our clients around the world. As a Corporate Banker, you will drive the client dialogue on capital structure, liability management, liquidity and funding strategies, risk management, and investment solutions. 
 Unique to Citi, Corporate Bankers are also responsible for deciding where to invest the firm's capital and executing on those investments. Corporate Bankers work in partnership with various Citi groups across the firm including Risk Management, Investment Banking and the Capital Markets. If none of these terms make sense right now, that's ok! Our internship is designed to help you increase your knowledge, so whatever your degree is in we will give you the training and support you need to excel. 
 We provide you with the knowledge and skills you need to succeed. 
 We're committed to teaching you the ropes. The 10-week summer analyst program starts in June and begins with one-week of training in UAE after which you will be placed with a Corporate Banking team to work with for the duration of the program. Successful summer analysts will be considered for a full-time position after graduation.

 Conduct accounting and financial statement analysis, cash flow modelling, and capital markets analysis

 Liaise with product partners

 Structure deals

 Commitment to personal growth and career development, a strong desire to learn, and success in team environments

description:
The position is described below. If you want to apply, click the Apply Now button at the top or bottom of this page. After you click Apply Now and complete your application, you'll be invited to create a profile, which will let you see your application status and any communications. If you already have a profile with us, you can log in to check status. 
 Need Help? 
 If you have a disability and need assistance with the application, you can request a reasonable accommodation. Send an email to Accessibility (accommodation requests only; other inquiries won't receive a response). 
 Regular or Temporary: 
Regular 
 Language Fluency:  English (Required)
 Work Shift: 
1st shift (United States of America) 
 Please review the following job description: 
This requisition is open to 2026 Truist Interns only. Applicants who were not 2026 Truist interns will not be considered.
Requisitions open to other external candidates will be posted at a later date if additional positions remain open for the Wholesale Client Coverage & Credit Analyst Program and the Enterprise Payments Analyst Program. 
The Role
As a Wholesale Analyst, you will build a strong foundation in financial services while developing the analytical, commercial, and relationship skills needed to support Truist clients. This two-year development program combines structured training, hands-on experience, rotational assignments, mentorship, and exposure to business leaders across Wholesale Banking. Analysts will have the opportunity to pursue one of two program paths: Wholesale Client Coverage & Credit or Enterprise Payments.
Wholesale Client Coverage & Credit: Build expertise in commercial banking, credit analysis, risk assessment, and relationship management. Following initial training, analysts complete rotations that provide experience in areas such as underwriting, financial analysis, portfolio management, specialized industries, real estate, and client coverage. The experience is designed to prepare analysts for future opportunities as credit professionals or bankers.
Enterprise Payments: Build an understanding of how payments solutions are developed, positioned, sold, implemented, and supported for clients. Following foundational credit and Payments training, analysts rotate across areas such as Sales, Product, Liquidity, and Client Solutions and Success, gaining an end-to-end view of the Payments business. Analysts also complete a defined-track experience designed to deepen exposure to a potential placement area and support readiness for roles across Enterprise Payments.
Across both paths, analysts will work on real business and client needs, collaborate with teams across Wholesale, and develop the technical knowledge, business judgment, and client perspective needed to begin a successful career in financial services.
What to Expect
Throughout the program, analysts will strengthen their analytical thinking, problem-solving, communication, presentation, collaboration, and client-focused skills while gaining practical exposure to their selected program path.
Analysts can expect:
Structured technical and business training at the start of the program, followed by hands-on rotational assignments.
Meaningful project work and exposure to real client, product, credit, and business scenarios relevant to their program path.
Mentorship, networking, peer connections, ongoing learning, and exposure to business leaders.
Opportunities to build both technical expertise and broader commercial understanding across Wholesale Banking.
Consideration for permanent placement at the conclusion of the two-year program based on demonstrated performance, skills, available roles, and business needs. Placement opportunities may be available across the Truist geographic footprint. 
 This requisition is open to 2026 Truist Interns only. Applicants who were not 2026 Truist interns will not be considered. 
 Requisitions open to other external candidates will be posted at a later date if additional positions remain open for the Wholesale Client Coverage & Credit Analyst Program and the Enterprise Payments Analyst Program. 
 Following is a summary of the essential functions for this job. Other duties may be performed, both major and minor, which are not mentioned below. Specific activities may change from time to time. 
 1.        Participate in an initial 4–6 week immersive training program designed to build foundational knowledge in credit fundamentals, financial statement and cash flow analysis, risk assessment, and commercial banking. Apply concepts through hands-on exercises, case studies, and real-world client scenarios in preparation for rotational assignments. 
 Following initial training, analysts will apply these skills in rotational assignments, with responsibilities varying based on business area and assignment and generally including: 
 2.        Analyze borrower financial statements, tax returns, cash flow, leverage, liquidity, repayment capacity, industry conditions, and other relevant information to assess creditworthiness and risk. 
 3.        Prepare financial spreads, projections, sensitivity analyses, risk-rating support, credit presentations, and written summaries for new requests, renewals, amendments, and periodic reviews. 
 4.        Support underwriting and transaction execution by gathering diligence, identifying key risks and mitigants, evaluating proposed terms, and coordinating with banking, credit, legal, operations, and risk partners. 
 5.        Assist with portfolio management activities, including annual reviews, covenant monitoring, exposure tracking, risk-rating evaluation, exception follow-up, and identification of emerging credit concerns. 
 6.        Make initial recommendations for credit worthiness of clients based on the analysis of client financial statements; make initial recommendations of action steps needed for client portfolios and highlighting emerging credit concerns, based on portfolio reviews. Make minor decisions on work execution. 
 7.        Support relationship and coverage teams in understanding client businesses, industries, financing needs, and opportunities to deliver lending, treasury, and other Wholesale Banking solutions. 
 8.        For assignments involving real estate, analyze property and market information, valuation fundamentals, operating performance, transaction structure, and risks across property types and client segments. 
 9.        Prepare clear presentations and communicate analysis, conclusions, and open items to teammates and business partners. 
 10.        Apply sound risk management practices; follow credit policy, applicable procedures, and documentation standards; protect confidential client and company information. 
 11.        Participate in mentorship, networking, coaching, leader exposure, and meaningful project work; demonstrate progress toward readiness for permanent placement. 
 QUALIFICATIONS 
 Required Qualifications: 
 The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. 
 This requisition is open to 2026 Truist Interns only. Applicants who were not 2026 Truist interns will not be considered. 
 Requisitions open to other external candidates will be posted at a later date if additional positions remain open for the Wholesale Client Coverage & Credit Analyst Program and the Enterprise Payments Analyst Program. 
 1.        Bachelor’s degree, or completion of a bachelor’s degree before the program start date. 
 2.        Overall GPA of 3.2 or above. 
 3.        Strong analytical, financial, problem-solving, and organizational skills. 
 4.        Superior written and oral communication abilities. 
 5.        Ability to learn quickly, manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and collaborate effectively in a fast-paced environment. 
 6.        Interest in financial services, credit, commercial lending, real estate, risk management, relationship banking, or commercial banking. 
 7.        Flexibility to potentially relocate based on program and business needs. 
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 1.        Coursework or experience in finance, accounting, economics, real estate, business analytics, or a related field. 
 2.        Understanding of financial statements, accounting concepts, cash flow analysis, or credit fundamentals. 
 3.        Experience with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, financial modeling, research, or preparing business presentations. 
 4.        Demonstrated teamwork, initiative, intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, and attention to detail through work, internships, academics, or extracurricular activities.

title: Real Estate Summer Intern | PGIM Ireland
description:
Real Estate Summer Intern – PGIM Ireland 
 Letterkenny (2 days in office) 
 A GLOBAL LEADING ASSET MANAGER WITH A DIVERSE & INCLUSIVE CULTURE 
 As the Global Asset Management business of Prudential, we’re always looking for ways to improve PGIM is the diversified asset management business of Prudential Financial, Inc. (NYSE: PRU). With $1.4 trillion in assets under management, and 38 offices spanning 16 countries, PGIM is among the world’s top 10 largest asset managers. Comprised of seven self-governing asset management divisions, each PGIM business offers a distinct workplace culture that aligns with the firm’s ultimate objective: to provide premier service to our clients while fostering an inclusive workplace culture that is rooted in trust, respect and equality. 
 PGIM Ireland are seeking to hire Interns for the PGIM Real Estate Loan Services (PRELS) team. PRELS are responsible for the servicing and asset management of commercial loans originated by PGIM Real Estate (PGIM RE). Irish hours will apply from Monday to Friday, however there is a requirement to be flexible, specifically during peak times. Hours are subject to change in line with role requirements. 
 At PGIM, You Can! 
 What you will do 
 • Servicing/Cash Management - loan level servicing including but not limited to billing, remittance reports, systems posting, cash management, loan disbursements, processing of borrower's requests. 
 • Surveillance Monitoring - including the review of property monitoring reports and inspections/appraisals. Provide analytical support including historical trend analysis, risk analysis, property valuation, market analysis, borrower and tenant credit analysis and covenant adherence. 
 • Banking Admin - managing multiple international banks and borrower relationships. 
 • Treasury – cash movements across multiple currencies & systems • Investor Reporting - Trustee reporting, Special Servicer reporting, wire remittance (CMBS, CME, FHA & Freddie Mac). 
 • Accounting Valuations – loan portfolio accounting, reporting and valuations. 
 • Investment and Corporate Accounting – cash lags, daily receipt accounts, monthly reconciliations and KIR reporting. 
 • Support construction asset management activities across international real estate portfolios, including tracking projects and capex updates, reviewing development-related information, and coordinating with servicing and surveillance teams on portfolio reporting and risk monitoring. 
 • Collaborate with finance teams reporting submissions and close tasks. 
 • Proactively communicate issues to relevant stakeholders. 
 • Cultivate both internal and external relationships to ensure proper service levels are achieved for each portfolio function. What you will bring 
 • Students of Finance, Accounting, Business Studies, Economics, Real Estate, Construction or Data Analytics preferred; however, we will consider candidates from any discipline once they can demonstrate relevant skillsets. 
 • Financial services acumen 
 • Ability to manage multiple responsibilities. 
 • Strong organizational, analytical and problem-solving skills 
 • Strong interpersonal skills with an ability to work collaboratively. 
 • Self-motivated, proactive, detail oriented, highly organized and exceptional time management 
 • Knowledge/experience of financial statements, commercial loans or other finance related areas beneficial 
 • Interest in construction, real estate development, or asset management, with strong attention to detail and an ability to coordinate across multiple teams and workstreams. 
 • Strong Microsoft Excel skills. 
 • Ability to work with Power BI a plus. 
 • Excellent oral and written communication skills
 *PGIM welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply. 
 About PGIM Real Estate 
 PGIM Real Estate is one of the largest Real Estate managers in the world and one of the nation’s largest full-service commercial, multi-family and agricultural real estate lenders and has been serving the commercial real estate market for over 125 years. We cover RE Debt, Equity, Agriculture, Public REIT securities, Defined Contribution, Private Equity, Impact Investing, Senior Housing and Mexico Industrial. PGIM Real Estate strives to deliver exceptional outcomes for investors and borrowers through a range of real estate equity and debt solutions across the risk-return spectrum. Our scope of insights, rigorous risk management and seamless execution are backed by a 50-year legacy of investing in commercial real estate, a 140-year history of real estate financing and the deep local expertise of professionals in 32 cities globally. Through our investment, financing, asset management and talent management approach, we engage in practices that ignite positive environmental and social impact, while pursuing activities that strengthen communities around the world. When you join our team, you’ll find yourself inspired by an inclusive company culture that believes that diversity of all kinds allows us to develop better and more innovative solutions for our client. 
 About Prudential Real Estate Loan Services (PRELS): 
 Prudential Real Estate Loan Services, Inc (“PRELS”) is a subsidiary of PGIM Real Estate. PRELS manages a wide variety of mortgage investments that include Prudential’s General Account, Institutional, CMBS, Fannie Mae, Freddie Mac and FHA loans. The Company is a rated Primary, Master, and Special Servicer.

title: Intern, Fund Legal and Governance (f/m/d)
description:
WHAT YOU WILL DO 
 As member of our Fund Legal & Governance team, you will report to the Fund Legal Manager. You will showcase your success through collaboration, ownership and innovation. Your expertise in emerging trends and practices will evoke stimulating discussions around optimization and change to help keep our competitive edge.
 This is a rare opportunity for a student to gather a meaningful experience in an exciting role within a top global Real Estate Asset Manager.
 WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT 
 Supporting team members with day-to-day operational and administrative tasks
 Handling incoming mail, including categorisation, scanning, and filing in documents management systems and hard-copy archives
 Maintaining organised electronic and physical records in line with established folder structures, naming conventions, and internal guidelines
 Updating and maintaining legal entity databases based on supporting legal documents
 Assisting in the development and maintenance of processes for the legal entity records and good governance practises
 Participating in the review and update of legal and corporate documentation
 Assisting with the organisation of quarterly board meetings of Luxembourg SPVs
 Taking and drafting minutes or resolutions when needed
 Assisting with AML/KYC requests and coordination with internal teams and service providers
 Collaborating efficiently and effectively with internal teams and third parties, including notaries, banks, transfer agents, tax advisors, auditors, etc.
 Supporting and coordinating the execution of the legal documents in electronic and wet-ink version
 Assisting timely registrations and filings with the Luxembourg Chamber of Commerce and other competent authorities
 Any other related tasks
 WHAT YOU WILL BRING 
 Strong academic background: the ideal candidate is pursuing a master’s degree preferably in business law or business administration 
 Good Excel skills and competence with other Microsoft Office applications
 Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, with flexibility to adapt
 Strong organizational and execution skills, with ability to prioritise tasks, identify urgent matters, and manage workload effectively
 Attention to details and ownership, taking responsibility for assigned tasks from start to completion and ensuring accurate and timely delivery
 Good interpersonal and communication skills, team player, capability to interface professionally with various internal and external stakeholders
 Clear and strong English verbal and written communication skills required; French, German or Italian is an advantage
 Self-starter and strong team player who is inquisitive and self-motivated
 General interest and familiarity with European financial regulation, investments and financial markets
 WHAT WILL SET YOU APART 
 Experience in working in an international and multicultural environment / have a global mindset
 Knowledge of the AIFMD is a strong plus
 WHY YOU WANT TO JOIN US 
 Offering flexibility and individuality, our opportunities align with the unique needs of our work, clients, teams, and lives.
 We understand that every role has its distinct requirements, so our managers treat their team as individuals, finding the way that works best for them to perform at the top of their game.
 We're not just talking about family friendliness! The majority of our employees have families; we enable flexible working hours while maintaining an in-office culture at the centrally located workplace in the heart of Luxembourg which is accessible with buses or tram.
 Fair remuneration is important to us. You will receive an attractive, performance-oriented salary and pension scheme benefits.
 Work is not everything. We regularly organize informative office events, summer and year-end parties. In addition, we offer 30 days of vacation per year and non-working days on Christmas and New Year's Eve to switch off.
 We support you in all situations! Together with partner companies as well as mental health first aiders, we offer life coaching, child and emergency care and individual assistance in challenging life situations.
 We are aware of our responsibility! The real estate industry is responsible for a large part of the global CO2 emissions - PGIM has set itself ambitious goals to change something and you can make your contribution!

With offices in 18 countries, PGIM’s businesses offer a range of investment solutions for retail and institutional investors around the world across a broad range of asset classes, including public fixed income, private fixed income, fundamental equity, quantitative equity, real estate and alternatives.

PGIM Public and Private Credit – Intern – 9-month placement Starting in Aug/Sept 2027. 
 This role will be based in Letterkenny onsite 2/3 days a week 
 A GLOBAL LEADING ASSET MANAGER WITH A DIVERSE & INCLUSIVE CULTURE 
 As the Global Asset Management business of Prudential, we’re always looking for ways to improve financial services. We’re passionate about making a meaningful impact - touching the lives of millions and solving financial challenges in an ever-changing world.
 We also believe talent is key to achieving our vision and are intentional about building a culture on respect and collaboration. When you join PGIM, you’ll unlock a motivating and impactful career – all while growing your skills and advancing your profession at one of the world’s leading global asset managers!
 If you’re not afraid to think differently and challenge the status quo, come and be a part of a dedicated team that’s investing in your future by shaping tomorrow today.
 At PGIM, You Can!
 What you will do 
 The PGIM Public and Private Credit Student Internship Programme is a 9- month placement running from August/September 2027. 
 To be eligible, you must be currently enrolled in a degree programme that requires you to complete an internship/placement as part of your studies. 
 You will work in a collegial and supportive environment that promotes and rewards individual contributions, while placing equal importance on the results of the larger team. You will be encouraged to share your insights, skills, and diverse perspective with a talented team that works toward common goals. We place high priority on maintaining an environment that develops, motivates, rewards, and retains employees. While on placement you will have the opportunity to rotate between different areas providing you with a comprehensive understanding of investment management.
 As part of a top global investment manager, you will have the opportunity to gain a fundamental understanding of investment and asset management. Based in Letterkenny, you will work with colleagues across the globe who will help you hone the skills required for your future successful career in finance.
 If you are studying a degree in Accountancy/ Finance/ Economics/Business we’d love to hear from
 you.
 What you can expect 
 Exposure to a global investment management firm and mentorship from experienced professionals in the field.
 Assisting with daily fund operations including responsibility for transaction processing, position reconciliation and cash management.
 Supporting the team in preparing financial reports and reconciliations, ensuring high standards of accuracy and timeliness are met.
 Helping to maintain records of fund activities, loan servicing and investor transactions.
 Collaboration with external service providers such as fund administrators, banking partners and auditors.
 What you will bring 
 Currently completing a degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, Business or related course and seeking a placement as part of that course.
 Successful candidates will have an inquisitive nature and a desire to deliver quality work.
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
 Proficiency in Microsoft Excel; familiarity with financial systems is a plus.
 Strong written and verbal communication skills.
 Ability to multi-task and absorb information across a broad spectrum of products.
 High-energy, positivity, geniality and optimism to a collaborative environment
 *PGIM welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply. 
 What we offer you 
 Health Insurance: PGIM Ireland partner with Laya and BUPA to provide health insurance schemes that cover eligible employee’s day to day medical and hospital expenses.
 Annual Leave: 23 days which are prorated based on contract duration
 Pension Scheme: Members of the scheme can contribute up to 8% of salary per annum and PGIM Ireland matches contributions up to 8% of salary. Members can also make voluntary contributions to the scheme.
 Annual Bonus Programme & Shop LK Vouchers: Along with an annual bonus employees are rewarded with Shop LK vouchers which are paid tax free.
 Life Assurance: fully paid by PGIM Ireland, employees are covered from their start date, and beneficiaries are provided with a lump sum of four times an employee’s salary.
 Education Assistance: PGIM Ireland have an Education Assistance Programme that reimburses eligible employees for furthering their education.
 About PGIM Public and Private Credit 
 PGIM Public and Private Credit is a global asset manager offering active solutions across all fixed income markets.
 Our business climate is a safe inclusive environment, centred around mutual respect, intellectual honesty, transparency, and teamwork. Our leaders are focused on talent & culture; dedicated to fostering growth & development at all levels to develop the industry leaders of tomorrow. For more information, please visit PGIM Public and Private Fixed Income 
- PGIM Ireland is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of applicants’ gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, race or membership of the traveler community. PGIM Ireland's aim is to hire the best people for the open roles and all appointments will be made on merit.
Any offer of employment made by PGIM Ireland will be contingent on receiving satisfactory references. Applicants should be aware that background checks will be carried out on all candidates offered a position within PGIM Ireland.
